items.title: Jack Kelly Interview, 1963-11-17
items.q: She's right on Demain Street, she's on Demain and Murray.

ctx.x: Yeah. He was something pretty, you know what I mean? Uh-huh. Well, she talks a lot about him, yet she, praise him for a lot of things that he did at the present time, you know? Yeah. In other words, he may have felt 10 foot tall. Mm-hmm. Where's she living now? She's right on Demain Street, she's on Demain and Murray.
Demain and Murray, I've never met her.
